lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 5 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is irregular with the widest gap located between the most posterior line and the second line moving anteriorly.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and third vertical lines from the posterior are truncated, terminating in the mid-lateral region of the torso without reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two discrete, high-contrast white circular spots are visible on the upper posterior hind limb/haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two spots on the posterior haunch are aligned on a near-horizontal axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral geometry; horns emerge dorsolaterally with an outward flare before curving medially and upward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.5 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 0.15 of the total vertical length of the horn structure.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.other_distinctive_markers: White inter-orbital chevron; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; high-contrast white dorsal crest extending along the spine; orange-tan pelage on lower limbs below the carpus and hock.
